name: polstools
description: Personal tooling: skills, commands, and scripts shared across AI coding harnesses from one repository.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Cross-harness working skills: design-fork judgment, goal conditions, doc-drift detection, repo privacy auditing, and branch-base checking.

plugins.name: windows
plugins.description: Windows-specific fixes and reference: terminal keybindings and other host quirks that only apply on Windows.

plugins.name: retro
plugins.description: Retrospectives from measured session history: find recurring friction, audit which standing rules and skills actually do anything, scout tooling against named seams, count stopped promises where a turn ended on an announced action that never ran, check whether a rule change moved what it was aimed at, and decide harness settings such as the prompt-cache TTL from what the machine did.

plugins.name: format
plugins.description: Fixed reply structure — findings, problems, asks, then everything else below a rule — injected at session start, reinforced every turn, and toggleable per session with /format:off.
